eyebrow: Safe to run more than once
code:
-- Idempotent: running this again changes nothing further,
-- because it only touches rows that still need the fix
UPDATE customers
SET state_code = 'CA'
WHERE state_code IN ('Calif.', 'California', 'CALIF')
  AND state_code <> 'CA';
caption: A WHERE clause that excludes already-fixed rows is what makes this idempotent.
